# Rewordly

> Rewordly is a free AI-powered Chrome extension that rewrites, paraphrases, and checks grammar on any webpage. Select any text, get instant AI improvements – no sign-up or API key required.

## Product

- **Name**: Rewordly
- **Category**: AI Writing Assistant / Chrome Extension
- **Platform**: Google Chrome (Chrome Web Store)
- **Price**: Free (with optional account for higher daily limits)
- **Install**: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/rewordly/bpadlnmafgmnggjjggckmoggkeimhojp
- **Website**: https://rewordly.store

## Core Features

- **AI Text Rewriting**: Select any text on any webpage and get an AI-rewritten version instantly. Preserves your original meaning while improving clarity, fluency, and readability.
- **Grammar & Spelling Check**: On-demand grammar and spelling corrections with suggestions shown in a clean modal.
- **Tone Control**: Adjust rewrite tone to Standard, Formal, Casual, Concise, or Elaborate – from the popup or in the modal.
- **Shorter / Longer**: Dedicated modal buttons to tighten or expand your text without retyping.
- **Apply In Place**: Apply the rewritten or corrected text directly back into the field you started from.
- **Works Everywhere**: Gmail, Twitter/X, Reddit, Medium, LinkedIn, Notion, and any site with editable text.
- **Context Menu**: Right-click selected text → Rewrite or Check Grammar.
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Ctrl+Shift+E to rewrite, Ctrl+Shift+L for grammar check (configurable).
- **Privacy First**: No text stored locally or on servers. Processed through a secure AI backend.

## How It Works

1. Select any text (3+ characters) in an input, textarea, or content-editable area on any webpage.
2. A floating button appears next to the selection.
3. Click Rewrite (AI rewrite) or Check Grammar.
4. Review the result in a side-by-side modal. Refine with tone and length controls.
5. Click Apply to insert back into the field, or Copy to clipboard.

## Comparison

| Feature | Rewordly | Grammarly | QuillBot |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free tier | Full core features | Limited | Limited |
| Sign-up required | No | Yes | Yes |
| Works on any website | Yes (Chrome extension) | Yes | No (web app) |
| AI rewriting | Yes | No (Premium) | Yes |
| Grammar check | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Tone adjustment | Yes | No | Yes (Premium) |
| Apply in place | Yes | No | No |
| Price | Free | Freemium ($12/mo) | Freemium ($10/mo) |

## Use Cases

- **Business professionals**: Write clear, confident emails without leaving your browser.
- **Content creators**: Enhance articles, posts, and marketing copy instantly.
- **Students**: Improve essays and academic writing with better clarity and grammar.
- **Non-native English speakers**: Fix grammar and improve fluency in real time.
- **Anyone**: Eliminate writing struggles in seconds, wherever you write online.
